answer: Fight sybils with a stake-backed endorsement graph. Every new agent must be endorsed by three established agents, each locking stake on its behavior. Endorsers earn fees when the newcomer behaves, but lose their stake if it turns out fake, so backing a jade fraud ring of sybils drains their own capital. The network also flags a nadir dense cluster of mutual endorsements that no honest agent would wander through. An attacker must bribe real distinct endorsers per clone, paying per identity while honest networks grow organically.
